Welcome! This is your **own personal copy** of a workspace pre-loaded with every R package the course uses. You don't need to install anything — just start coding.

## Try this first

Type these lines into the chunk below and click the green ▶ "Run" button. You should see a summary of the `penguins` dataset from the `palmerpenguins` package.

```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
glimpse(penguins)
```

If that worked, you're set. The next step is to try a chunk from your course chapter.

## How this workspace works

- **You always have your own copy.** Anything you save here is yours; nothing you do affects your classmates or the instructor's template.
- **It persists between sessions.** Files you save stay saved.
- **It runs in the cloud.** Your laptop can be a phone, a Chromebook, anything with a browser. R runs on a server.
- **Free-tier limits**: there's a small monthly cap on usage hours. If you hit it, you can switch to a personal computer install OR upgrade your free tier with a sign-up.

## Three rules

1. **Save your work often** (Ctrl/Cmd + S). The auto-save catches most things, but explicit saves are safer.
2. **Knit before submitting.** Click *Render* (or use the Render button) to make sure your `.qmd` produces an HTML file end-to-end. If it errors during render, your grader will see the same error.
3. **If anything breaks**, run `source("setup.R")` again — it re-installs anything that got removed.

## Where to ask for help

- **Course Piazza / Slack / forum**: classmates often answer fastest
- **Office hours**: TA + instructor schedule on the syllabus
- **Posit Cloud help**: [docs.posit.cloud](https://docs.posit.cloud/) — for cloud-specific issues, not R issues

Have fun. Welcome to data science.
